about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Passionate about creating exceptional digital experiences
about.para1: I'm a Front-End Engineer with 3+ years of production experience building complex, data-intensive web applications. I hold an M.Sc. in Computer Engineering from Iran University of Science and Technology and am recognised by the National Elite Foundation.
about.para2: I'm an active contributor to OpenMetadata — a leading open-source data catalog and governance platform — with merged pull requests spanning UI components, localization, and feature enhancements. I deliver pixel-perfect, accessible, and performant interfaces using React, TypeScript, and modern state-management solutions.
about.para3: I thrive in agile, cross-functional teams and enjoy architecting scalable component libraries, driving performance optimisations (code-splitting, lazy loading, memoisation), and leading full RTL localisation efforts. Every project is an opportunity to push the boundaries of what's possible on the web.

items.description: Architected a reliable multi-GB file upload module using Uppy.js and TUS resumable-upload protocol with pause/resume, automatic retry, and support for Excel, JSON, TSV, and CSV formats.

items.title: Front-End Engineer
items.description: Architected a large-file upload module (Excel, JSON, TSV, CSV) using Uppy.js and TUS protocol enabling reliable multi-GB transfers. Built Mapping Table & Column interfaces (Databricks-inspired) for ETL workflows. Developed a full-featured Data Catalog UI and a Role Management module with dynamic access-control. Led full Persian (RTL) localisation using i18next across the entire product. Drove performance optimisations reducing initial load time. Owned end-to-end delivery of the Add Pipeline page.

items.title: Front-End Developer (Graduate Internship)
items.description: Contributed to production-grade telecom dashboards using React, Redux Saga, and Material UI within a large enterprise codebase. Implemented responsive UI components with Sass/CSS following design-system guidelines. Integrated Webpack build pipelines and Nginx-based deployment via Docker.
